operational-excellence.name: Operational excellence
operational-excellence.focus: Run and monitor systems, and continually improve processes and procedures.

security.name: Security
security.focus: Protect data, systems and assets; manage identities, detect events, and respond.

reliability.name: Reliability
reliability.focus: Recover from failures and meet demand: foundations, workload architecture, change and failure management.

performance-efficiency.name: Performance efficiency
performance-efficiency.focus: Use computing resources efficiently as demand and technology change.

cost-optimization.name: Cost optimization
cost-optimization.focus: Deliver business value at the lowest price point.

sustainability.name: Sustainability
sustainability.focus: Minimize the environmental impact of running cloud workloads.

generative-ai-lens.scope: Applications using foundation models on Amazon Bedrock or customer-managed models on Amazon SageMaker AI (and Amazon Q). For classic ML see the Machine Learning Lens.

designPrinciples.name: Design for controlled autonomy
designPrinciples.text: Guardrails and boundaries govern how AI systems operate, scale and interact.

designPrinciples.name: Implement comprehensive observability
designPrinciples.text: Measure security, performance, cost and environmental impact at every layer, including user feedback and model behavior.

designPrinciples.name: Optimize resource efficiency
designPrinciples.text: Right-size models and data operations from empirical requirements, with dynamic scaling.

designPrinciples.name: Establish distributed resilience
designPrinciples.text: Redundancy, automated recovery and geographic distribution keep service available through failures.

designPrinciples.name: Standardize resource management
designPrinciples.text: Central catalogs and controls for prompts, models and permissions: versioned, governed, cost-aware.

designPrinciples.name: Secure interaction boundaries
designPrinciples.text: Least privilege, secure communications, input/output sanitization and monitoring on every interface.
